name: overview renders live data from every module
expect: Six KPI cards: Weight, Steps, Workouts, Streak, Calories, Medications
Weight reads 78.4 kg with a date underneath, not a dash
Steps reads an em-dash with 'not logged yet' — the placeholder, so the grid keeps six columns
Nutrition card shows three labelled macro boxes and a water progress bar
Training card lists a Running session with duration and distance
The three overview cards end at the same height, so their footer buttons align

name: log water saves via preset chip
expect: The water dialog shows four preset chips (250/330/500/750 ml) and a custom field
The chosen chip is visibly selected
After saving, the dialog closes, a toast confirms the amount, and the water bar advances

KPI labels read Peso, Pasos, Entrenos, Racha, Calorías, Medicamentos
The macro boxes read Proteínas, Carbohidratos, Grasas

name: empty module shows a guiding empty state
expect: Reports how many rich empty states are on the page — expected 0 now that all three modules have data.
